hypotheses.G0_global_transport_replicates: The ungated map has coordinate fidelity between 0.70 and 0.85 on every corpus.
hypotheses.G1_low_rank_context_materially_improves: Rank-8 context gating improves coordinate fidelity by at least 0.05 over the global map on every corpus.
hypotheses.G2_context_gating_explains_transport: Rank-16 context gating reaches coordinate fidelity at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.G3_context_gating_predicts_graph_changes: Rank-16 context gating reaches selected-edge-change fidelity at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.G4_position_is_not_the_explanation: Position-only gating improves coordinate fidelity by less than 0.05 over the global map on every corpus.
hypotheses.G5_context_rule_transfers_ood: Rank-16 coordinate fidelity on each OOD corpus is within 0.05 of disjoint FineWeb.
hypotheses.G6_more_context_does_not_overfit_badly: Rank-32 context fidelity is no more than 0.03 below rank-16 on every corpus.
